g.text: The request only reserves the project and enqueues a job. export-github does the work in durable steps; the GitHub token never leaves the server.
→ GitHub consent → back to the dialog
5. tx: lock project row, reserve operation EXPORT,
GithubExport(QUEUED) with the frozen READY Version
9. recover-sandbox: resume, or rebuild from READY Version
10. prepare-files: write the saved version, read the tree
14. repository: create, or reuse ours (provenance marker)
16. push: update branch ref, never force
Any step failing after retries → record-export-failure: FAILED + errorCode, reservation released.
github.retry re-queues the same job with attempt + 1 and the same frozen commit inputs.
